It is a fact lookup, not a dispute reply, so it drafts no letter. SEED FACTS. Skill supplier-dispute-reply (Skills/supplier-dispute-reply/SKILL.md): use when drafting a reply to a supplier who disputes an invoice or payment; steps: 1 open with the invoice number and date as the supplier wrote them; 2 state the purchase-order rate and the purchase order number; 3 offer exactly one weekday-morning call slot; 4 admit no liability and promise no payment date; 5 sign off as 'Accounts team'. Larkspur Print (organization entity, tag supplier): print supplier for warehouse labels; purchase order PO-4471 agrees 0.12 EUR per label; invoices paid within 30 days.
